# In-process environment policy examples. No commands are executed.
# Each block starts with `case NAME`. `keep` and `check` take space-separated table entries;
# `env` and `set` take one NAME=VALUE each; `secure_path` takes a PATH. An `expect` line is
# NAME=VALUE, !NAME for an absent variable, or `reject` for a rejected command-line assignment.
# Supply a different fixture through SUDO_RS_ENV_CASES.

case preserve
keep SUDOENV_SAMPLE
check TZ
env SUDOENV_SAMPLE=hello
env SUDOENV_OTHER=world
env TZ=UTC
expect SUDOENV_SAMPLE=hello
expect !SUDOENV_OTHER
expect TZ=UTC

case check
keep SUDOENV_LABEL
check SUDOENV_LABEL SUDOENV_MODE
env SUDOENV_LABEL=alpha/beta
env SUDOENV_MODE=normal
expect !SUDOENV_LABEL
expect SUDOENV_MODE=normal

case pattern
keep SUDOENV_COLOR=blu*
env SUDOENV_COLOR=blue
expect SUDOENV_COLOR=blue

case secure
keep PATH
secure_path /usr/bin:/bin
env PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin
expect PATH=/usr/bin:/bin

case assignment
keep SUDOENV_SAMPLE
set SUDOENV_SAMPLE=hello
expect SUDOENV_SAMPLE=hello

case unlisted-assignment
keep SUDOENV_SAMPLE
set SUDOENV_OTHER=world
expect reject
